headline: Turn feedback noise into evidence the product trio can debate
capabilities: Aggregate customer feedback from diverse sources into a single view
Analyze sentiment and identify top pain points and feature requests
Prioritize items based on impact and automate Jira ticket creation
Alert teams to churn risks and competitive gaps for proactive intervention
outcomes: Reduced feedback analysis time from weeks to minutes
Delivered data-driven prioritization for roadmap planning
Prevented churn through early detection of at-risk accounts
Accelerated feature delivery and improved customer satisfaction
why_try: The demo lets a product manager ask a natural question and receive a source-backed, reviewable answer with the approval boundary visible in the response.

sample_prompts.label: Product Manager: Cross-channel feedback summary
sample_prompts.prompt: Give me the cross-channel feedback picture before the weekly product review.

sample_prompts.label: Engineering Lead: Feature-request evidence ranking
sample_prompts.prompt: Rank the feature-request evidence for review, but do not turn it into a roadmap.

sample_prompts.label: Director of Product: Sentiment and NPS evidence
sample_prompts.prompt: What are the strongest sentiment signals in the fictional customer snapshot?

sample_prompts.label: Product Manager: Roadmap review candidates
sample_prompts.prompt: Frame the impact tradeoffs the product trio should validate before sequencing work.

business_flow: Product, engineering, design, and customer teams
CRM, support, survey, and product feedback sources
